rows.en: (Today I came to the ranch with Claire-senpai!)
Wow... They're so big...
rows.notes: x6: Claire x4; twice with no name plate (after the player's 'N-nothing!'), so kept neutral.

rows.en:
So they're raised by Zentradi people.
I had no idea.

With a size like that, the amount of milk
they give must be on a whole other level.

It had a real pastoral feel to it.
That was fun, wasn't it?

Yes. I had fun getting to see you
so excited, Senpai.
Geez, the things this kid says...
rows.notes: Claire refers to the player as 'kono ko'.

rows.en: Well then, let's head home~
(Today I came to the ranch with Claire-senpai.)

So they're raised by Zentradi people.
I had no idea at all.

I had fun too, getting to see you
so excited, Senpai.
(Today was a nice change of pace~)
(Today I came to the ranch with Claire-senpai again!)

Wow... They're so big...
So that's the hippo-cow the milk comes from...
I wonder how much milk you get from just one.
I wonder how much that'd be in soft serve...
rows.notes: Soft-cream equivalent of the milk. Review: 'soft serve' unhyphenated throughout.

rows.en: (Senpai can't resist sweets either, huh...)
You look like you want to say something?

Today was fun too.
Let's come out here again sometime.
Yes, I had fun spending time with you, Senpai.
Same here. Flattery or not, that makes me happy.
Well then, shall we head home?
(Today I came to the ranch with Claire-senpai again.)
I wonder how much milk you get from just one?
(Senpai can't resist sweets either...)
(Today I came to study with Claire-senpai!)
All right, no chitchat. Let's work hard, okay?
There's no time for goofing off~
(Senpai's in fired-up mode again today...)
Come on, come on, quit spacing out!
Mmm~ Nothing beats tea after studying.

What's with you... going all limp like that.
Sit up straight, okay?
After our tea, we're going shopping~
(Senpai sure is full of energy...)
(Today I came to study with Claire-senpai.)
(I'm studying with Claire-senpai again today.)
Stop chitchatting and let's get started already~
(Senpai's in fired-up mode again today, huh...)
Come on, come on, keep those hands moving!
Mmm~ Tea after studying is something special.

What's with you... after just a little studying...
You're such a slacker, you know?
Okaaay, sorryyy.

After our tea we're going shopping, you know.
So get your strength back, okay?
(Senpai really is full of energy...)
(I'm studying with Claire-senpai again today.)
(Senpai's in fired-up mode again today, huh...)
(Today I came out shopping with Claire-senpai, but...)

\p-kun,
did you find anything?
rows.notes: 'Nanika atta kashira' read as 'found anything (in the shops)?'; the player answers he is just wandering.

rows.en:
I'm just wandering around, but...
Senpai, is there anywhere you want to go?

I followed you because you were walking this way...
Don't tell me you had no plan at all?
Honestly, what am I going to do with you...
That hot dog was delicious, wasn't it?
Just the thing after a nice walk.
Well then, shall we keep shopping?
(Today I came out shopping with Claire-senpai, but...)

\p-chan,
did you find anything?

(I came out shopping with Claire-senpai again
today, but...)
Um... where should we go today?

You mean you were walking around without a plan?
That's no good. You need to escort me properly.

No matter how many times I eat them,
I never get tired of the hot dogs here.

They're good, but make sure you decide
where we're going next, okay?
O-okaaay...

(I had fun hanging out with Claire-senpai
all day today.)

No matter how many times I eat them,
the hot dogs here never get old, right?

uncertain: c05002/c05010: Claire's 'nanika atta kashira' read as 'did you find anything?' (they are out shopping and the player replies he/she is just wandering); could also be 'is something up?'.
c04956 (x6): two occurrences have no name plate (likely Claire with a missing plate); 'Wow... They're so big...' works for either speaker.
